content.text: I have a complete picture of the sample. Let me verify one last detail on the payload blob and imports usage.

input.file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW-w64/GCC 13 built (debug symbols retained; source name windows_level20_RemotePEExecution.c)

injection_details.method: Remote PE execution / manual PE mapping: OpenProcess(0x43A) -> VirtualAllocEx(NULL, SizeOfImage, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE 0x40) -> NtWriteVirtualMemory of PE headers (SizeOfHeaders) -> per-section loop writing each IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER's raw data to remoteBase+VirtualAddress with NtWriteVirtualMemory -> base relocation processing -> CreateRemoteThread(hProc, NULL, 0, remoteBase+AddressOfEntryPoint, NULL, 0, NULL) -> WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 10000) -> CloseHandle + NtClose
injection_details.target_discovery: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS)/Process32First/Process32Next, strcmp() against PROCESSENTRY32.szExeFile; if not found falls back to GetCurrentProcessId() (self-injection)
injection_details.payload_write: NtWriteVirtualMemory (resolved dynamically from ntdll.dll via GetModuleHandleA+GetProcAddress) instead of imported WriteProcessMemory; headers first, then section-by-section copy
injection_details.relocation_handling: Reads IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_BASERELOC (NT header +0xB0), walks relocation blocks, for each entry (offset = word & 0xFFF) uses ReadProcessMemory to read the 8-byte target in the remote process, adds delta = remoteBase - OptionalHeader.ImageBase, and writes it back with NtWriteVirtualMemory
injection_details.payload_source: 64-byte RC4-encrypted blob 'g_encrypted_pe' in .data (0x140004000), copied to stack and decrypted in-place before injection
injection_details.post_injection: Sleep(2000) in the injector before returning

encryption_details.algorithm: RC4 (custom implementation: rc4_init KSA over 256-byte S-box + rc4_crypt PRGA XOR)
encryption_details.key: R3m0t3_PE_3x3c_K (16 bytes, ASCII, no NUL terminator)
encryption_details.key_storage: Hard-coded plaintext byte array 'g_rc4_key' in .rdata at VA 0x140005000 (52 33 6D 30 74 33 5F 50 45 5F 33 78 33 63 5F 4B); passed to rc4_init with length 0x10

decoded_strings.g_encrypted_pe (.data:0x140004000, 0x40: 7de35a8c1fb446d92e81f73b65ca08924a1cbd73e85d319f06fc78dd238a51b714e06bcd38a50f72d6499e35fb11872c60aa19f44d83e57a3ec19658b026dd6f — decrypted at runtime with RC4/'R3m0t3_PE_3x3c_K' and then treated as an in-memory PE image (MZ/PE signatures validated by get_pe_image_size/get_pe_entry_point) to be mapped into the remote process
decoded_strings.plaintext API/target strings (not encryp: ntdll.dll, sbiedll.dll, dbghelp.dll, SymSetOptions, NtWriteVirtualMemory, NtClose, explorer.exe

anti_analysis: Sandboxie detection: GetModuleHandleA("sbiedll.dll") — if loaded, anti_sandbox_check() returns 1 and WinMain calls Sleep(30000) then exits without injecting
Analysis/debugger tooling detection: GetModuleHandleA("dbghelp.dll") followed by GetProcAddress("SymSetOptions") to confirm the debug-help library is present

Dynamic (non-import-table) resolution of ntdll functions NtWriteVirtualMemory/NtClose via GetModuleHandleA+GetProcAddress, hiding the memory-write primitive from the import table (no WriteProcessMemory import)
Sleep-based timing/delay behaviour (Sleep(30000) on detection, Sleep(2000) after injection)
